title: FAA UAP reports, batch 06 (237UAP00132 - 237UAP00157)
doc_notes: This document is a batch of FAA Skywatch incident reports regarding UAP sightings, most of which describe distant lights or balloons, with one close-approach encounter reported.

encounters.summary: A small circular object with flashing white lights appeared 10 feet off the nose of a commercial aircraft before departing.
encounters.entity_appearance: small circular object with flashing white lights
encounters.quote: what appeared to be 10 feet off the nose
